title_en: 2 Apartment 1+1 for sale at Rr. of Kavaje, Near the 21st of December Crossroads - Tirana (ID D8142Z2)
description_en: On Rruga e Kavajes, near the Crossroads of 21 December, 2 Apartments 1+1 are for sale, with a total area of ​​65 m², located on the 5th (top) floor of an existing red brick building. Apartment 1 is organized in a living room + kitchen, 1 bedroom, 1 toilet and balcony (closed) Apartment 2 is organized in a living room, a separate kitchen, 1 bedroom and 1 toilet //*for more details, see the floor plan in the photo gallery The apartments have been completely reconstructed and the terrace is insulated. They are sold furnished as in the photo and with all the necessary appliances. They are invested, laid with parquet and with air conditioning in every environment. They have ownership certificates (with mortgage) Ideal for investment - both for daily rent (Airbnb, Booking) and for long-term rent, thanks to the premium location and high development potential, this property guarantees a safe and sustainable return on investment. Sale price: 193,000 euros. (Both apartments) //*sold together
